title: The Chair Nobody Pulls Out

mood.label: Heavy going, talks ruled out
mood.summary: Thirty-eight out of a hundred: Washington ruled out Iran talks while Tehran promised an asymmetrical answer, Ukraine hit a ship at Sochi, Nepal-China flood deaths passed 1,270 and Ebola passed 3,000 - offset by a market rally, German grid money and a Pacific climate declaration.

lines: All options open, and no chair pulled out -
the strait keeps score in shipping lanes.
A hull burns off Sochi, the oil climbs,
and the market ends the week up one.
Twelve hundred and seventy under the flood,
the dam crews still not found, still not counted.
Three thousand gone in Congo; trials come in the fall.
One-point-five stops being a thing that we can hold.
Thirty-eight of a hundred, heavy going, holding on -
Germany buys back a winter's worth of light,
a court hands the map to the people it was drawn on,
and Palau signs the sea a promise in the dark.
